<!--
  Disclaimer: submitting your music in no way guarantees its
  inclusion. Contrary to popular belief, Faux Fetus _is_ somewhat
  curated. It has to be. If it weren't it would just be archive.org,
  which you should feel free to upload your music to if your
  submission is woefully rejected.
-->

**Artist name(s)**

The name of the artist(s) you're wanting to submit

**Album name(s)**

The album(s) of the aforementioned artist(s)

**File format**

- [ ] V0 MP3 (preferred)
- [ ] Crapper-than-V0 MP3 (fine)
- [ ] Lossy, non-MP3 files (no thanks)
- [ ] Lossless WAV or Flac files (I can work with that)

**Metadata**

<!--
  The site is generated from MP3 files that are "tagged" with APEv2 metadata. It would be very nice if you (a) knew what this meant and (b) could submit files that are properly tagged.

  Required tags:
  - Title: the track title
  - Artist: the artist name
  - Album: the album name
  - Track number: (optional) the single digit number of the track
  - Composer: (optional, but recommended) the name(s) or pseudonym(s) of the people who worked on the track
    - For multiple names, use pipe delineation: My Name|Another Name

  If you can't use APEv2 tags, I can convert them for you so long as the files have ID3v1 or ID3v2 tags.
-->

Are your audio files "tagged" properly?

- [ ] Yes (thank you)
- [ ] No (I hate you)

If you answered "No", are you able to "tag" your audio files?

- [ ] Yes (then do it now, please)
- [ ] No, again ([HATING INTENSIFIES])

If you answered "No, again", I'm going to need a list of all track titles, in order, and, optionally, the people who played on the track.

<!--
  1. My Awesome Track - Rhonda Dongus
  2. Dog's Can't Die - Rhonda Dongus & Flappy McGoo
  3. ... etc.
-->

**File URL**

Please paste a URL to the location of your files so that I may download them.
